items.author: wanderering-nerd.bsky.social
items.context: Honest question to anyone who sees this: PSP or Steam deck?
items.text: Depends on what you want to play. The Deck runs a big part of the Steam library, and each store page shows a Verified label so you know before buying.

items.author: kjartankennedy.com
items.context:
Recently I've been better about buying games and working through my backlog, but I haven't done a great job of keeping up with upcoming games. That said, this was an opportunity to realize that Hillthorn, which I'm looking forward to, comes out next week!
image: Capsule art for Hillthorn, featuring several spooky silhouettes set against a bright orb.; quotes @causewaystudios.com: There are so many highly anticipated games dropping this month, so for #QuestionsWithCauseway this week, we wanna know... Which November re…
items.text: Backlog first is a solid plan. Wishlisting upcoming games on Steam sends you a notice at release, so you don't have to keep track yourself.

items.author: trevorsideas.bsky.social
items.context: GoG Galaxy is coming to Linux. I know that's been requested heavily so that's nice to hear as well. Only other announcement that caught my attention is a GoG Social platform for discussing games. Yet another social media? Ugh... I don't know...
items.text: Galaxy on Linux is a big one for people who asked for it. GOG games are DRM-free anyway, so you can keep the installer and run them without the launcher too.
items.verify: Проверьте: GOG Galaxy для Linux действительно анонсирован (так написано в посте автора).
